To produce the total installed cost, use the retrofit labor multiplier: 16 This report is available at no cost from NREL at www.nrel.gov/publications. Low installed cost: $4.20/sq. ft. × 1.28 = $5.38/sq. ft. Mid installed cost: $6.03/sq. ft. × 1.28 = $7.72/sq. ft. High installed cost: $12.40/sq. ft. × 1.28 = $15.87/sq. ft. Therefore, the median material price is $6.03 per square foot and the labor cost is $1.69 per square foot, for a total installed cost of $7.72 per square foot.
